title: Restart the Bluetooth service when the adapter stops responding
summary: When Bluetooth stops working, check that its background service is stuck, then restart it and confirm the adapter is back. All connected Bluetooth devices disconnect during the restart.
prerequisites: Save any work that depends on a Bluetooth device, such as a file transfer in progress

steps.explain: Check whether the Bluetooth service is running. This only reads the status and changes nothing. Press q to leave the output. Look at the 'Active:' line: 'active (running)' means the service is fine, so go to step 2; 'failed' or 'inactive (dead)' means it is stuck or stopped, so continue to step 3.
steps.expect: A line like 'Active: active (running)' when the service works, or 'Active: failed' or 'inactive (dead)' when it is stuck.

steps.explain: Ask the Bluetooth adapter for its state. This is read-only. Look for 'Powered: yes' and a 'Controller' line. If you see 'No default controller available', the system does not see any adapter, and a restart will not help.
steps.expect: A 'Controller' line with the adapter address and 'Powered: no' or 'Powered: yes'. 'No default controller available' means no adapter was found.

steps.explain: Restart the Bluetooth service. Every connected Bluetooth device (keyboard, mouse, headphones) disconnects, and the service starts again by itself. Run this only if step 1 showed a stuck or stopped service, or step 2 shows the adapter not answering.
steps.expect: Usually no output when it works; the command asks for your password first. If it prints an error, the service did not restart: run step 1 again to read the status.

steps.explain: Check the adapter again after the restart. Devices can take a few seconds to reconnect.
steps.expect: 'Powered: yes' means the adapter is on again.

verify.expect: Prints 'active' when the Bluetooth service is running.

rollback.explain: A restart changes no settings, so there is nothing to undo. If the service stays stopped after the restart, go back to step 1 and read the status line again.

warnings: Restarting the Bluetooth service disconnects every connected Bluetooth device. Reconnect them after the restart.
Restart only when the service is stuck or the adapter does not answer. The status checks in steps 1 and 2 are safe to run at any time.
The restart needs your administrator (sudo) password.
